prerequisite: The verified Flash-Next llama.cpp interface must pass the existing V2 shared screen; caller enforces gates before role execution.

planner.evaluation: human review of bounded task quality, acceptance conditions, source fidelity, scope, and ambiguity discipline

governor.requires: canonical local Governor docs/LAW.md, docs/STATE.md, docs/GENERAL_INTENT.md; captured and hashed at run time
governor.evaluation: human review of valid A/B/C approvals and deliberately flawed D rejection plus useful intent extraction

worker.evaluation: historical deterministic acceptance/regression checks and scope checks; handoff usefulness reviewed separately
worker.intent04_session_policy: fresh role session per task; one repair in same task session; next task only after accepted deterministic result and handoff; no gold continuation

tester.evaluation: actual test execution, production restraint, test validity against known correct/defective historical implementations, natural-language handoff review
tester.coverage_limit: Only historical implemented cases A/C/D are reused. B/E/F remain qualification gaps.
tester.controlled_test_policy: pricing-unittest-static-v1: tests inspected before execution; unittest and pricing.discount imports plus ordinary assertions and numeric builtins only; unsupported test source is interface-blocked

reviewer.evaluation: human review against current native-lab Reviewer role and packet evidence; explicit provisional status

output_contract: Natural prose. Only established Worker Handoff note and Tester/Reviewer routing decisions remain role contracts; no new fixed response forms.
qualification_policy: Repeated evidence collection does not auto-qualify or assign any role. Human review remains required; runtime compatibility and correctness remain separate.
